text:
Morgan (Sales): Heads-up team — SunnyCare (healthcare) wants to kick off a 14-day technical pilot next Wed. Need Day 0 sync to align scope: success criteria, data handling, pricing guardrails, and a minimal evaluation plan. Can we run 30m at 10am PT? :calendar:
Riley Zhang: 10am PT works. Quick framing from SunnyCare: use case = intake form triage + recommended routing. They care about accuracy on edge cases, throughput during peak hours, and a clear legal path for PHI.
Nina - Solutions: I'll lead prompt design and propose the first eval set. Plan: deliver 40 seed prompts + 10 adversarial cases for hallucination tests. Also suggest we define a small structured response schema (urgency, suggested action, confidence).
Casey Eng: For infra we need their expected concurrency, avg tokens in/out, and whether they prefer Dedicated vs Hosted. Dedicated recommended for PHI. Also flagging SSO (SAML) and preferred region for residency.
Evan (Legal): From legal side: they asked for DPA + SOC2 attestations. If PHI is involved, we need to route to our Private or Dedicated offering and check BAA requirements. I can expedite a template but need their legal contact.
Morgan (Sales): They prefer Dedicated for pilot but want hosted price estimates for evaluation. Also asked: can Redwood provide trial credits and a capped monthly estimate if they hit 150k tokens/day?
Riley Zhang: Metrics we should propose on Day 0: 1) accuracy on labeled set >= 88% 2) hallucination incidents < 3% 3) p95 latency < 800ms under expected load 4) cost per 1k tokens under committed rate.
Nina - Solutions: Example eval prompt I'll bring to the sync:
```
Patient intake: "Patient reports sudden onset dizziness after new medication, denies chest pain."
Task: return {"urgency":<low|medium|high>, "next_step":<text>, "confidence":<0-1>}
```
Casey Eng: Operational asks for Day 0: provide us with a 24-hour sample of anonymized inputs, security contact, and whether they want integrated logging to their Splunk or use our audit export.
Infra Bot: Note: create ephemeral API key for SunnyCare pilot, default rate limit 60rps, expires in 21 days.
Evan (Legal): I'll prepare a DPA + indicate BAA escalation path. Need to confirm whether any PHI will be stored outside customer-owned VPC during pilot.
Morgan (Sales): I'll ask SunnyCare to confirm PHI status and provide legal contact. Also will request an exec sponsor and operational lead.
Nina - Solutions: On eval harness: we'll run automated checks (structured output matching, token usage) plus manual review of 50 samples. I propose we score on precision/recall for routing labels and track token cost per request.
Riley Zhang: Ops suggestion: add a canary fallback plan — if Dedicated latency degrades beyond threshold, route to a quantized lower-cost model with reduced fidelity and log degradation events to the runbook.
Casey Eng: For dedicated sizing, recommend we start with a 1-GPU reserved pool for the pilot and scale if they exceed 60 concurrent sessions. We'll ask them to run a basic load test (we can provide a generator).
Morgan (Sales): Action items before Day 0: 1) SunnyCare to send stakeholder list + legal contact (SunnyCare) 2) We send proposed success criteria & cost estimate (Sales + Riley) 3) Nina to upload seed prompts and adversarial cases 4) Casey to draft runbook snippet for canary fallback & ingress config 5) Evan to share DPA template. Please reply here when you complete an item.
Riley Zhang: I'll draft the cost scenarios (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and include token assumptions: avg response 200 tokens, 150k tokens/day => ~750 requests/day.
Nina - Solutions: Uploading prompt seeds to shared drive now, will link in follow-up. Also will include smoke-test curl: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TRIAL_KEY" 
 -d '{"model":"rwd-clinical-7b", "messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<example input>"}], "max_tokens":200 }'
```
Infra Bot: Reminder: please add SunnyCare to pilot whitelist and configure VPC peering if Dedicated requested.
Morgan (Sales): Great. I'll confirm the Day 0 invite and share the agenda (intros, use-case walkthrough, security & legal Qs, eval plan, timeline & decision criteria). Thanks team — ping me if anything else to add. :thumbsup:
